description: This file implements the StateTransitionHandler class for managing state transitions within a plugin system. It includes thread management, synchronization primitives, and request handling logic.

classes.name: StateTransitionHandler
classes.description: Manages state transition requests, runs a dedicated thread for processing requests, and provides singleton access.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the StateTransitionHandler.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the handler, starts the request processing thread.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Stops the request processing thread and cleans up.

methods.name: addRequest
methods.description: Adds a new state transition request to the queue.
